path_prefixes: frames/ and requests/ are in this test set
path_prefixes.flow-states-20261022/: the folder of the pimpleFoam run without model requests

window_rule.note: windows are placed at random around the fastest cell of each state; x stays inside the domain, y may reach below the bottom wall (white, no cells)

oct17_numeric_summary.scope: saved fluid snapshot; identical numeric evidence in both benchmark conditions
oct17_numeric_summary.residual_definition: normalized linear-solver residual; not force imbalance; recent values are chronological, last is current; fixed delta_t_s separates samples

image.render: each cell drawn as its own polygon in its own colour, no interpolation; colour range is each panel's min/max; top panel |U|, bottom panel p

note: Same states, prompts, renderers and scoring as picture-test-20261021; only the plotted window differs per request. The runner replaces only the model name.
